statement: Expiry is off-chain only (the chain's clause has none): anyone lapses an offer by a frame once the deciding party's view is strictly past its deadline plus the reserve (R-HTLC-CLOCK rules); earlier is not_expired with the earliest height. A lapse removes the offer and its reservations, keeps what was filled, and no fill follows it.
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); plan/swap-onchain.md; coordinator 10-01

killers.name: account/swap R-SWAP-EXPIRE an offer expires off-chain: a frame lapses it once the view is past due
